Bootstrap 5.3.8
Source: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.8
License: bootstrap-5.3.8/LICENSE (MIT)
The compiled CSS is distributed unchanged. The optional development source map
and JavaScript plugins are not bundled; the application uses its own controls.

Pretendard 1.3.9
Source: https://github.com/orioncactus/pretendard/tree/v1.3.9/packages/pretendard/dist/web/variable
License: pretendard-1.3.9/LICENSE (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
PretendardVariable.woff2 is distributed unchanged. pretendard.css is a local
font-face declaration that preserves the application's Pretendard family name.

Google Material Symbols, Sharp, 24px, default weight 400
Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4/symbols/web
License: material-symbols-sharp/LICENSE (Apache License 2.0)
Selected SVG paths are bundled in symbols.svg as named symbols. Their original
coordinate systems are preserved; the application supplies the current text color.
